messages:
Hannah: Heads-up: scheduling a controlled v2 rollout for api.redwood.com on Thu 01:00 UTC. Plan: staged percentages 7% (20m) -> 30% (40m) -> 100% (60m). Region order: eu -> us -> apac. We have a compatibility shim for clients that need the v1 envelope.
DeployBot: rollout scheduled id=roll_6990012345_v2_gradual time=2026-09-02T01:00:00Z stages=[7,30,100] regions=[eu,us,apac] operator=@hannah
Carlos: Quick question: will enterprise tenants get shimmed? we should avoid changing their shape.
Hannah: No, enterprise_tier is excluded. We'll use an exclude pinlist so they see native v2 only.
Mei: Pinlist path please so I can sync with partner ops.
Hannah: I'll upload exclude list to /releases/v2/pinlists/exclude-enterprise-2026-09.txt.gz and add it to deploy args.
Carlos: Also add a header opt-in for legacy clients: X-RI-Compat: legacy. New SDKs won't set it.
Mei: SDK team will post a note; we'll encourage partners to set the header if they need the envelope.
SupportLead: I'll prepare support KB and canned messages for stage1 and stage2. Link when ready.
OpsBot: Monitoring hooks: p95 latency, 5xx rate, client-schema-errors, and telemetry-success-rate. Alerts: 5xx >1.5% for 5m => page, p95 increase >200ms for 10m => notify.
Hannah: Proposed rollback rules: rollback current stage if any of: sustained 5xx >1.5% for 5m, p95 +200ms baseline for 10m, schema-errors >0.5% for 10m. On rollback we revert to previous config and open #incidents.
Carlos: I'll run preflight canary: 300 synthetic requests across eu/us in -10m window to validate shim and native shapes. Will post results.
Mei: Uploaded exclude-enterprise-2026-09.txt.gz (sha256: f47ac10b).
DeployBot: Example command used in CI:
```
deploybot rollout create --id roll_6990012345_v2_gradual \
  --stages 7,30,100 \
  --regions eu,us,apac \
  --exclude /releases/v2/pinlists/exclude-enterprise-2026-09.txt.gz \
  --shim-mode header-optin \
  --operator hannah
```
DeployBot: will emit stage-start, stage-complete, and stage-rollback events to this channel and attach telemetry snapshots.
SupportLead: Draft KB: https://internal.docs/redwood/kb/v2-compat-optin.md (includes how to set X-RI-Compat and how to opt-out).
Carlos: Preflight results: 300/300 passed; shim returns choices envelope when header present, native payload for others. Latency within baseline.
OpsBot: Alerts primed for window; will temporarily lower thresholds by 10% to reduce noise.
Hannah: Final checklist: exclude file (done), SDK note (Mei), support KB (SupportLead), deploybot scheduled (ack). Call to arms -10m in this thread.
SupportLead: Notifying customer success + top partners now.
Hannah: Thanks — standby and report any anomalies immediately. :rocket:
